# The Python side of the interop job (CI's python-interop job; the moduledoc
# of Encryptor.PythonInterop says how to run it locally). The AWS Encryption
# SDK for Python 4.0.7 with the Material Providers Library (the `mpl` extra),
# and every package it installs on Python 3.12, pinned by exact version with
# every sha256 PyPI lists for that version. Install with:
#
#     python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt
#
# pip refuses a package whose file matches no hash here, and a dependency
# missing from this list; the --require-hashes line below turns that on even
# when the flag is left off the command. Regenerating: resolve
# `aws-encryption-sdk[mpl]` at the new version with `pip download` into an
# empty directory, then take each resolved version's sha256 list from
# https://pypi.org/pypi/NAME/VERSION/json.
